hero.title: Meet, Futubra!
hero.description: It’s somehow unfair that all social networks in Russia are in the hands of one person, don’t you think?

recommendations.title: No recommendations
recommendations.info: The news feed contains only what you subscribed to and without recommendations to add your ex and her new boyfriend as friends

combine.title: No extra features
combine.info: Looking for delivery, horoscope, weather forecast, music and marketplace? Wrong tab, buddy

friends.title: No friends
friends.info: Only subscriptions to user content that is interesting to you

likes.title: No likes
likes.info: We don’t want to see posts with kittens on a regular basis for the sake of gaining ratings?

blacklist.title: No blacklists
blacklist.info: Don't you like what the other person writes? Don't read it, it's not difficult

ads.title: No brands
ads.info: Personally, I can’t get enough of their advertising on the Internet and in my mailbox

entry-delete.title: Delete entry
entry-delete.help: For some reason you are going to delete the post, are you sure this is really necessary?

comment-delete.title: Delete comment
comment-delete.help: For some reason you are going to delete the comment, are you sure this is really necessary?
